description: Searches the Work Insiders directory of 1,000+ recruiting, HR, sales prospecting and AI tools by free text and filters: category, first party MCP server, API, free plan, free trial, AI-native and maximum starting price. Returns up to 25 tools per page, each with its starting price, flags and Work Insiders page link. Full detail on one tool comes from workinsiders_get_tool.

ai_native.description: Only tools that ship real AI features.

category.description: Category slug or name, for example "ats", "sourcing" or "Email finders". The full list comes from workinsiders_list_categories.

free_plan.description: Only tools with a free plan or free tier.

free_trial.description: Only tools with a confirmed free trial.

has_api.description: Only tools with a public API.

has_mcp.description: Only tools whose vendor runs its own (first party) MCP server.

max_monthly_price.description: Maximum starting price in USD per month. Tools with a free plan count as $0. Per seat prices count one seat, yearly prices are divided by 12, and quote-only or pay-per-use tools are left out.

offset.description: Number of results to skip. next_offset in a response is the start of the next page.

query.description: Free text such as a tool name or a job to be done ("LinkedIn outreach", "AI interview notes"). Optional.

sort.description: Sort order. Default relevance (editor picks first when there is no query).

name: workinsiders_search_tools
title: Search recruiting and HR tools
